checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same golden retriever recognisable in same pose
must.why: Same pose, sitting facing camera with tongue out, golden coat; looks like a redraw but is recognisable.
Eyes, nose, tongue and fur are much sharper.

must.item: Fur and edges natural, no halos or invented detail
must.why: Looks natural, though the detail is invented and slightly AI-smooth.
Trees, park, cars and grass are in the same layout, with new detail invented in the background.

must.item: 640 px long edge and source aspect ratio preserved
must.why: The output appears to be about 512x512, not 640. The source looks square, so the aspect ratio is kept.

faults.what: Output is about 512 px, not the 640 px requested, while the reply claims 640
The image is a regeneration, so fur, eyes and background detail are invented rather than recovered, and the look is slightly over-saturated and AI-like

summary: The dog photo is much clearer and still looks like the same dog and scene, but the output is about 512 px instead of the requested 640 px, and the reply wrongly says it is 640.
